headline: UK-EU Youth Mobility and Agrifood Deals May Face Implementation Delays Until 2030
summary: A planned post-Brexit youth mobility scheme and agrifood pact between the UK and EU could see full rollout delayed until 2030, despite a summit expected to agree on core principles this week.
why: Cross-border labor arrangements and food trade rules impact UK and EU agricultural supply chains and labor availability.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Postponed implementation delays expected cross-border labor and agrifood trade facilitation.
